name: okx-agentic-wallet
description: OKX Agentic Wallet — the single skill for the user's wallet and on-chain execution. Use it whenever the user wants to operate their wallet or execute an on-chain action, including: login & accounts, balance / holdings, wallet address / deposit / receive, send / transfer, contract calls (approve / deposit / withdraw), transaction history & status, message signing, wallet export & policy; pay gas with a stablecoin (Gas Station, Solana); swap / trade / buy / sell / convert, get a quote; cross-chain
author: internet-court
summary_zh: 面向 AI 智能体的钱包与链上操作工具，适合统一处理账户查询、转账、合约调用、交易兑换及跨链等需求。
